decisions.reason: Removing the Android-oriented Youku integration does not change the iOS modernization requirement or its current attributes.
Removing Youku may incidentally affect implementation size, but it does not change the requirement to minimize the Android application's size.
The Youku removal does not alter the confirmed scope or behavior of full-app Android localization.
Removing the Youku integration does not change the policy to remove unused Android permissions or the identified READ_PHONE_STATE permission.

The Youku integration is represented as an independent requirement; its removal does not cancel or modify the remaining Android OS, deprecated-API, dependency, and maintainability modernization obligations.
The removed Chinese Youku integration was identified in the Android workstream and does not change the iOS size-optimization requirement.
The Youku removal does not alter the confirmed scope or behavior of full-app iOS localization.
The Apple-required Privacy Manifest remains necessary regardless of whether the separate Youku integration is removed.
Removing the Youku integration does not affect the need for valid iOS signing certificates and configuration.
The Youku removal does not change required right-to-left layout behavior for Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian locales.
